status: DRAFT — nothing here is confirmed, nothing here is deliverable, and the server does not read this file. The geofence uses the confirmed boundary in PostgreSQL and refuses delivery when there is none.

properties.name: UPES Bidholi campus (proposed outline)
properties.note: NOT VERIFIED ON THE GROUND. Nobody has walked this perimeter. 113 of 114 field readings fall inside it and the official UPES pin is 9 m from the nearest reading, which is corroboration, not confirmation — every reading is an interior point. Reading #098 (30.414623, 77.970043) falls OUTSIDE and is unresolved. The campus geofence stays fail-closed until an administrator confirms a walked perimeter.
